requirements.title: Keyboard-first assistance inside the existing note-taking Métis
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve note-taking; global show/hide plus a separate command-voice toggle. Keyboard, mouse and typed access converge on existing controllers with truthful capture/task indicators. No end-user coding tools.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Talk/Guide/Do/Dictate separation
requirements.required_behavior: Intent selects a mode; Guide cannot click; Dictate cannot submit.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Scoped useful autonomy
requirements.required_behavior: Explicit safe local requests run within resource, capability, route and time limits without repetitive prompts.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Stable authorized input before effects
requirements.required_behavior: Partial/meeting/playback/tool-origin text cannot authorize mutation.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Exact consequential approval
requirements.required_behavior: Approval binds exact current recipients/content/resource/amount and is consumed once.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Truthful speech and labels
requirements.required_behavior: Done/saved/sent and success cues require verified host receipts; model prose cannot override unknown.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Speech interruption is not task cancellation
requirements.required_behavior: Status questions and output language changes yield audio without rerunning or cancelling the task.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Local stop, pause and correction
requirements.required_behavior: Revoke dispatch locally; reconcile in-flight effects; revalidate before resuming.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Actual audible position and stale-chunk fences
requirements.required_behavior: Flush queued audio, account for heard position and reject late response chunks.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Grounded visible guidance
requirements.required_behavior: Use fresh target, window/revision/transform and distinguish presentation from physical input.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: One physical input owner
requirements.required_behavior: Exclusive device-level fence survives revocation until native drain acknowledgment.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Human takeover wins
requirements.required_behavior: Stop injection immediately; no stale replay or focus fighting.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Honest background activity
requirements.required_behavior: Show real task state and results, never simulated mouse activity as execution proof.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Durable operation and resource identity
requirements.required_behavior: Reserve before effects; duplicates and unresolved same-resource operations cannot bypass quarantine.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Independent postcondition verification
requirements.required_behavior: Read back the actual target; absent desired result alone is not proof of zero effects.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Partial completion remains partial
requirements.required_behavior: Aggregate all operations in the exact plan; no vacuous or first-step Done.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Correct follow-up and agent identity
requirements.required_behavior: Resolve selected agent/task/proposal; ask on ambiguous references; names do not grant rights.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Safe verbatim dictation
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve text/language/numbers; focus changes pause; rewrite and submit require distinct intent.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Quiet and authorized output
requirements.required_behavior: Suppress private unprompted output on calls/sharing; current audience and actual output route govern speech.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Visible governed memory
requirements.required_behavior: Approved preferences/outcomes only; canonical lineage, correct/forget, current access, no authority escalation.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Readiness grounded in probes
requirements.required_behavior: Saved credentials are Checking until a real scoped probe; unavailable routes remain explicitly unavailable.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Useful results, safe undo and recovery
requirements.required_behavior: Open verified artifacts; preserve partial outputs; undo only a valid verified inverse.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Preferences and teaching do not expand authority
requirements.required_behavior: Speech preferences remain scoped; skill teaching produces a reviewed draft; routines need separate authority.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim

requirements.title: Native/live proof on exact builds
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve r11/expansions and platform gates; no fixture, patch or PR is deployed behavior.
requirements.scope: Normative requirement, not a deployed claim
